title: Quarkus REST client and Quarkus REST with abstract resource - NATIVE build fails
body:

`AbstractGreetingResource$$QuarkusRestClientInterfaceCreator` looks a bit strange.

If I switch to quarkus-resteasy-client and quarkus-resteasy, things work well.

### Expected behavior

Native compilation works.

### Actual behavior

Native compilation fails

### How to Reproduce?

 - `sdk use java 21.0.2-graalce`
 - `git clone git@github.com:rsvoboda/abstract-quarkus-rest-repro.git`
 - `cd abstract-quarkus-rest-repro`
 - `mvn clean verify -Dnative`


### Output of `uname -a` or `ver`

macOS

### Output of `java -version`

Java 21

### Quarkus version or git rev

Quarkus main / Quarkus 3.14.1

### Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`)

_No response_

_No response_
